arabic text: YASRAB SE SUWE KARBALA, IK KARWAAN RUKHSAT HUWA\nSAR PE ALAM SAAYA FIGHAN, GHAZI(A.S) KI AATI HAI SADA\nPEHLA SAFAR ZAINAB(S.A) KA HAI, SUNSAAN KARDO RAASTA
english translation text: From Yathrib towards Karbala, a caravan departed.\nA standard cast its shade above them, while Ghazi's voice called:\nthis is Zainab's first journey—clear the road.

arabic text: KYA SHAAN HE KYA DAB DABA, KYA LOG HEIN QURAANUMA\nSALLE ALA SALE ALA AYAAT KA HE QAAFLA, MASHKO ALAM INKA NISHAAN
english translation text: What majesty and dignity! What Qur'anic people! Blessings upon them—the caravan itself\nis formed of verses. The water-skin and standard are their signs.

arabic text: ALLAH(J.J) KE PYAARE HEIN YE, AALE NABI(S.A.W.W) SAARE HEIN YE\nQURAN KE PARE HEIN YE, KAUNAIN KE TARE HEIN YE\nZERE QADAM HE ASMAAN, ABBAS(A.S) MEERE KARWAAN
english translation text: They are Allah's beloved ones, all the Prophet's family.\nThey are sections of the Qur'an and stars of both worlds.\nThe heavens lie beneath their feet; Abbas is the caravan's leader.

arabic text: KOI SHABIH-E-MUSTAFA(S,A.W.W), KOI HASSAN(A.S) KA DILRUBA\nHAI KOI AKS-E-SAYYEDA(S.A), SHABBIR(A.S) KA YE QAAFILA\nTHAAME ALAM JO HAI JAWAAN, ABBAS(A.S) MEERE KARWAAN
english translation text: One is Mustafa's likeness, another Hasan's beloved.\nOne is the image of the Sayyida—this is Shabbir's caravan.\nThe young man holding the standard is Abbas, leader of the caravan.

arabic text: YASRIB SE TABA KARBALA, HAR DIN TAWAAFE KAAFILA\nABBAS(A.S) KARTA HI RAHA, PARDE KA ZIMMEDAAR THA\nYUN MUTMAIN THI BIBIYAAN(SA.), ABBAS(A.S) MEERE KARWAAN
english translation text: From Yathrib until Karbala, Abbas continued circling the caravan each day.\nHe remained responsible for the women's privacy.\nIn this way, the ladies travelled in peace; Abbas was the caravan's leader.

arabic text: ABBAS(A.S) WOH KIRDAAR HE, BA’ADE ALI(A.S) SALAAR HAI\nAYSA ALAM BARDAAR HAI, MAYDAN MEIN BE TALWAR HE\nPHIR BHI ALAM KA PAASBAAN, ABBAS(A.S) MEERE KARWAAN
english translation text: Abbas is that character: after Ali, he is commander.\nSuch a standard-bearer, without even drawing his sword,\nyet still guardian of the standard—Abbas, leader of the caravan.

arabic text: LO AGAYA USKA ALAM, GHAZI(A.S) JISE KEHTE HEIN HUM\nKEHTE CHALO YE DAMBADAM, ABBAS(A.S) MEER-E-LASHKARAM\nBABUL HAWAAIJ MEHRABAAN, ABBAS(A.S) MEERE KARWAAN
english translation text: Behold, his standard has arrived—the one we call Ghazi.\nKeep repeating: Abbas is the leader of my army.\nThe Gate of Needs is merciful; Abbas is the caravan's leader.

arabic text: JAB SHAAM POHONCHA QAFLA, KHUTBA YE ZAINAB(A.S) NE DIYA\nSUNLE YE QAUM-E-ASHKIYA(L.A), HUM HEIN BINA-E-LAILAAH\nKASHTI HE DEE(N) HUM BAADBAA(N), ABBAS(A.S) MEERE KARWAAN
english translation text: When the caravan reached Shaam, Zainab delivered this sermon:\nlisten, O people of oppression—we are the foundation of 'La ilaha'.\nWe are the ark of faith and its sail; Abbas is the caravan's leader.

arabic text: THA HASHR MEIN MOLA ALI(A.S), YE “SARWAR-O-REHAN” BHI\nNAZRE KARAM SE AAPKI, RAKHTE HEIN UMMEED-E-QAWI\nNAWHON SE DENGE YE BAYAAN, ABBAS(A.S) MEERE KARWAAN
english translation text: O Sarwar and Rehan, at Resurrection Maula Ali will be present.\nThrough his merciful gaze, you hold strong hope.\nThrough your laments you will proclaim: Abbas is the caravan's leader.
